title: fix: replace z.custom() with proper zod schema for OpenAPI generation
author: rekty
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the non-serializable `z.custom<ModelMessage>()` field with a JSON Schema-compatible permissive schema.
- Restores `/api/docs/open-api/generate-schema` without changing runtime validation behavior.
- Unblocks generated API reference updates.

Fixes #13558

gist.headline: The schema blooms again
gist.blurb: A tiny Zod knot was keeping the API reference garden from growing. The docs generator is back to producing healthy OpenAPI schema leaves.
gist.summary: Replaced the non-serializable z.custom<ModelMessage>() field in the prompt-agent runtime with a permissive JSON Schema-compatible Zod schema, restoring /api/docs/open-api/generate-schema without changing runtime validation.
gist.impact: Developers can again generate OpenAPI schemas and update API references, while prompt-agent message validation keeps behaving the same way.
gist.visual_concept: Depict API schema generation as a cozy code-garden: a blocked or tangled schema vine has been replaced by a neat, flowering JSON-schema plant feeding a retro documentation terminal. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, carefully tends the plant while the monitor robot happily reads the newly generated API reference.
